exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Lie flat with eyes under the bar. Grip just wider than shoulders, brace, and unrack. Lower to mid-chest with control, then press back to lockout.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Set the bench to 30–45°. Lower the bar to the upper chest, keeping the elbows tucked slightly, and press back over the collarbone.

exercises.name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Secure your legs on a decline bench. Lower the bar to the lower chest and press back to lockout.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Lie flat holding dumbbells at chest height. Press up until the arms are straight, then lower until you feel a stretch across the chest.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.instructions: On a 30–45° bench, press the dumbbells from the upper chest to arms-straight, keeping the wrists stacked over the elbows.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Fly
exercises.instructions: With a slight bend in the elbows, open the arms wide until you feel a chest stretch, then bring the dumbbells back together.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
exercises.instructions: On an inclined bench, open the arms in a wide arc and return, keeping the elbow angle fixed throughout.

exercises.name: Cable Fly
exercises.instructions: Set the pulleys high or mid. Bring the handles together in front of the chest, pause, and return under control.

exercises.name: Cable Crossover
exercises.instructions: From high pulleys, sweep the handles down and across the body, crossing slightly at the bottom.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.instructions: Set the seat so the handles sit at mid-chest. Press forward to nearly straight arms and return under control.

exercises.name: Pec Deck
exercises.instructions: With the elbows on the pads, bring the arms together in front of the chest and squeeze before returning.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.instructions: Hands under the shoulders, body in a straight line. Lower until the chest is just off the floor and press back up.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
exercises.instructions: Hands on a bench or box. Lower the chest to the surface and press back, keeping the hips level.

exercises.name: Decline Push-Up
exercises.instructions: Feet elevated on a bench. Lower the chest to the floor and press back without letting the hips sag.

exercises.name: Chest Dip
exercises.instructions: Lean the torso forward on parallel bars. Lower until you feel a chest stretch, then press back up.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Set the bar over mid-chest. Unrack, lower with control, and press back to lockout.

exercises.name: Svend Press
exercises.instructions: Press a plate between the palms straight out in front of the chest, squeezing throughout.

exercises.name: Band Chest Press
exercises.instructions: Anchor the band behind you at chest height and press the handles forward until the arms are straight.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Bar over mid-foot. Hinge, grip just outside the knees, brace, and stand up by driving the floor away. Keep the bar against the legs.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Take a wide stance with the hands inside the knees. Push the floor apart and stand tall.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions: From standing, push the hips back with soft knees until you feel a hamstring stretch, then drive the hips forward.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Stand inside the trap bar, hinge to the handles, brace, and stand up tall.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
exercises.instructions: Hinge to roughly 45°. Pull the bar to the lower ribs, squeeze the shoulder blades, and lower under control.

exercises.name: Pendlay Row
exercises.instructions: From a flat back parallel to the floor, pull the bar explosively to the chest and return it to the floor each rep.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.instructions: Brace one hand on a bench. Pull the dumbbell to the hip, keeping the shoulders square.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench and row the dumbbells to the ribs.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.instructions: Sit tall, pull the handle to the navel, and let the shoulder blades separate on the way out.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row
exercises.instructions: Hinge over the bar, pull the handles to the chest, and lower with control.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.instructions: Hang from an overhand grip. Pull until the chin clears the bar, then lower to full extension.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
exercises.instructions: Hang from an underhand grip and pull until the chin clears the bar.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: Pull the bar to the upper chest with the elbows driving down, then control the return.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: Using a narrow neutral grip, pull to the chest and squeeze the lats at the bottom.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
exercises.instructions: With nearly straight arms, sweep the bar down to the thighs, then return overhead.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.instructions: Hang under a fixed bar with the body straight and pull the chest to the bar.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.instructions: Pull the rope to the face with high elbows, ending with the hands beside the ears.

exercises.name: Barbell Shrug
exercises.instructions: Stand tall and lift the shoulders straight up, pause, and lower fully.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shrug
exercises.instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and shrug the shoulders straight up.

exercises.name: Back Extension
exercises.instructions: On a 45° bench, hinge down and extend back until the body is in a straight line.

exercises.name: Good Morning
exercises.instructions: With the bar on the upper back, push the hips back until the torso is near parallel, then stand.

exercises.name: Rack Pull
exercises.instructions: Set the bar at knee height in a rack and pull to lockout.

exercises.name: Meadows Row
exercises.instructions: Stand side-on to a landmine bar and row the end of the bar to the hip.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.instructions: From the front rack, brace hard and press the bar overhead, moving the head through at lockout.

exercises.name: Push Press
exercises.instructions: Dip at the knees, drive up, and use the momentum to press the bar overhead.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.instructions: Press the dumbbells overhead from shoulder height and lower to ear level.

exercises.name: Arnold Press
exercises.instructions: Start with the palms facing you, rotate outward as you press overhead, and reverse on the way down.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions: Raise the dumbbells out to shoulder height with a soft elbow, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions: With the pulley low and behind you, raise the handle out to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Machine Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions: Press the pads outward to shoulder height and lower under control.

exercises.name: Front Raise
exercises.instructions: Raise the dumbbells in front to shoulder height, keeping the torso still.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly
exercises.instructions: Hinge forward and open the arms wide to shoulder height, leading with the elbows.

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck
exercises.instructions: Facing the pad, sweep the arms back and squeeze the rear delts.

exercises.name: Upright Row
exercises.instructions: Pull the bar up the front of the body to chest height with the elbows leading.

exercises.name: Landmine Press
exercises.instructions: Press the end of a landmine bar from the shoulder up and slightly forward.

exercises.name: Cuban Rotation
exercises.instructions: With the elbows at shoulder height, rotate the forearms up and back, then reverse.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
exercises.instructions: Hold a band at shoulder height and pull it apart until the arms are wide.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Keeping the elbows at your sides, curl the bar to shoulder height and lower fully.

exercises.name: EZ Bar Curl
exercises.instructions: Curl the EZ bar with the wrists in the angled grooves, keeping the elbows still.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Curl the dumbbells with the palms up, avoiding any swing at the hips.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.instructions: Curl with a neutral grip, thumbs up throughout.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Lie back on an incline bench, let the arms hang, and curl without moving the elbows forward.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
exercises.instructions: With the upper arms flat on the pad, curl to the top and lower to a full stretch.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl
exercises.instructions: Brace the elbow on the inner thigh and curl the dumbbell to the shoulder.

exercises.name: Cable Curl
exercises.instructions: Curl a low-pulley bar to shoulder height with the elbows pinned.

exercises.name: Spider Curl
exercises.instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench and curl the dumbbells straight up.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Grip about shoulder width, tuck the elbows, and press from the lower chest.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown
exercises.instructions: With the elbows at your sides, extend the arms down and squeeze at lockout.

exercises.name: Rope Pushdown
exercises.instructions: Push the rope down and spread the ends apart at the bottom.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Extension
exercises.instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands and lower it behind the head, then extend.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher
exercises.instructions: Lying flat, lower the bar toward the forehead by bending only at the elbow, then extend.

exercises.name: Triceps Dip
exercises.instructions: Keep the torso upright on parallel bars, lower to about 90° at the elbow, and press up.

exercises.name: Bench Dip
exercises.instructions: With the hands on a bench behind you, lower the hips and press back up.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-Up
exercises.instructions: Place the hands close together under the chest and lower with the elbows tucked.

exercises.name: Wrist Curl
exercises.instructions: Rest the forearms on a bench and curl the wrists up, then lower fully.

exercises.name: Reverse Wrist Curl
exercises.instructions: With the palms down and the forearms braced, lift the backs of the hands upward.

exercises.name: Reverse Curl
exercises.instructions: Curl with an overhand grip, keeping the wrists straight.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
exercises.instructions: Hold heavy weights at your sides and walk with tall posture for distance or time.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.instructions: Bar on the upper back, brace, and sit down between the hips until at least parallel. Drive up through mid-foot.

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.instructions: With the bar in a front rack, keep the elbows high and the torso upright as you squat.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.instructions: Hold a dumbbell at the chest and squat between the knees, keeping the chest tall.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.instructions: With the back on the pad, lower until the knees reach about 90° and press back up.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.instructions: Lower the sled until the knees approach the chest without the hips rolling, then press.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.instructions: With the rear foot on a bench, lower straight down until the front thigh is parallel.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.instructions: Step forward and lower the back knee toward the floor, then drive through the front foot.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.instructions: Step backwards, lower the back knee, and return to standing.

exercises.name: Step-Up
exercises.instructions: Step onto a box, driving through the whole foot, and lower under control.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.instructions: Extend the knees fully against the pad, pause, and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
exercises.instructions: Curl the pad toward the glutes and lower without letting the hips lift.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.instructions: Curl the pad down and under, keeping the thighs pinned.

exercises.name: Nordic Curl
exercises.instructions: With the ankles anchored, lower the torso forward as slowly as possible and pull back up.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.instructions: With the upper back on a bench and the bar over the hips, drive the hips to full extension.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.instructions: Lying on the floor, drive the hips up until the body is in a straight line and squeeze.

exercises.name: Cable Kickback
exercises.instructions: With a cuff on the ankle, drive the leg back and up, then return under control.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction
exercises.instructions: Press the knees outward against the pads and return slowly.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction
exercises.instructions: Squeeze the knees together against the pads and return under control.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.instructions: Rise onto the toes as high as possible, pause, and lower into a full stretch.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.instructions: With the knees bent under the pad, press onto the toes and lower fully.

exercises.name: Tibialis Raise
exercises.instructions: With the heels down and the back against a wall, pull the toes up toward the shins.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.instructions: Dip and jump onto a box, landing softly with the knees tracking over the toes.

exercises.name: Sled Push
exercises.instructions: Drive the sled forward with short, powerful steps and a braced torso.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
exercises.instructions: Hinge and hike the bell back, then snap the hips forward to float it to chest height.

exercises.name: Zercher Squat
exercises.instructions: Hold the bar in the crooks of the elbows and squat with an upright torso.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Squat
exercises.instructions: With the feet slightly forward, squat along the fixed bar path and press back up.

exercises.name: Pistol Squat
exercises.instructions: Balance on one leg, lower to the bottom with the other leg extended, and stand.

exercises.name: Belt Squat
exercises.instructions: With the load on a hip belt, squat down and drive back up without spinal loading.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instructions: Hold a straight line from head to heels on the forearms, ribs down and glutes tight.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.instructions: Stack the feet and hips and hold a straight line on one forearm.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.instructions: Hanging from a bar, raise the legs to hip height or above without swinging.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.instructions: Hanging from a bar, draw the knees up to the chest and lower with control.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.instructions: Kneel under a high pulley and crunch the ribs toward the hips.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.instructions: Roll out as far as you can hold a neutral spine, then pull back with the abs.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.instructions: Sit leaning back and rotate the ball from hip to hip.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.instructions: On your back with the ribs down, extend the opposite arm and leg, then return.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.instructions: On all fours, extend the opposite arm and leg and hold without rotating the hips.

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.instructions: Stand side-on to a pulley and press the handle straight out, resisting rotation.

exercises.name: Sit-Up
exercises.instructions: With the feet anchored, curl up to a seated position and lower with control.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.instructions: Lift the shoulder blades off the floor by curling the ribs down, then lower.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
exercises.instructions: Alternate bringing each elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
exercises.instructions: From a push-up position, drive the knees to the chest one at a time at pace.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.instructions: Press the lower back into the floor and hold the arms and legs off the ground.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.instructions: Carry a single heavy weight at one side without leaning.

exercises.name: Power Clean
exercises.instructions: Pull the bar from the floor, extend the hips explosively, and catch it in a front rack.

exercises.name: Hang Clean
exercises.instructions: From mid-thigh, extend the hips and pull under the bar into a front rack.

exercises.name: Power Snatch
exercises.instructions: With a wide grip, pull the bar from the floor and receive it overhead with straight arms.

exercises.name: Clean and Jerk
exercises.instructions: Clean the bar to the shoulders, then dip and drive it overhead to lockout.

exercises.name: Thruster
exercises.instructions: From a front squat, stand explosively and press the bar overhead in one movement.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.instructions: Drop to a push-up, jump the feet back in, and finish with a jump.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Clean
exercises.instructions: Hike the bell back and guide it to the rack position at the shoulder.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Snatch
exercises.instructions: Swing the bell and punch through at the top to lock it out overhead.

exercises.name: Turkish Get-Up
exercises.instructions: From lying, stand up while keeping the bell locked out overhead, then reverse.

exercises.name: Wall Ball
exercises.instructions: Squat with the ball at the chest, then stand and throw it to a target on the wall.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-Up
exercises.instructions: Use the counterweight to pull the chin above the bar with good control.

exercises.name: Assisted Dip
exercises.instructions: Use the counterweight to lower to about 90° and press back up.

exercises.name: Machine Row
exercises.instructions: With the chest on the pad, pull the handles to the ribs and squeeze.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.instructions: Press the handles overhead from shoulder height and lower to ear level.

exercises.name: Machine Biceps Curl
exercises.instructions: With the upper arms on the pad, curl the handles up and lower fully.

exercises.name: Machine Triceps Extension
exercises.instructions: Extend the arms against the pad and return under control.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
exercises.instructions: Facing away from a low pulley, hinge back and drive the hips forward to stand tall.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchop
exercises.instructions: Rotate from high to low across the body, keeping the arms fairly straight.

exercises.name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
exercises.instructions: From crossed cables, sweep the arms wide and back at shoulder height.

exercises.name: Cable Overhead Triceps Extension
exercises.instructions: Face away from the pulley and extend the rope overhead until the arms are straight.

exercises.name: Cable Hammer Curl
exercises.instructions: Curl a rope with a neutral grip, keeping the elbows fixed.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Row
exercises.instructions: Hinge over the fixed bar and row it to the lower ribs.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.instructions: Seated under the bar, press overhead along the fixed path.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
exercises.instructions: With the bar on the back and the toes on a plate, rise onto the toes and lower fully.

exercises.name: Landmine Row
exercises.instructions: Straddle a landmine bar and row the handle to the chest.

exercises.name: Landmine Squat
exercises.instructions: Hold the end of a landmine bar at the chest and squat with an upright torso.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Pullover
exercises.instructions: Lying across a bench, lower one dumbbell behind the head and pull it back over the chest.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.instructions: Lying on the floor, press the dumbbells until the triceps touch down between reps.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Hinge with the dumbbells tracking down the legs until you feel a hamstring stretch.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Balance on one leg and hinge forward, letting the free leg extend behind you.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Thruster
exercises.instructions: Squat with the dumbbells at the shoulders and press them overhead as you stand.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Snatch
exercises.instructions: Hinge, then drive the dumbbell from between the legs to overhead in one pull.

exercises.name: Band Face Pull
exercises.instructions: Pull a band to the face with high elbows and squeeze the rear delts.

exercises.name: Band Squat
exercises.instructions: Stand on the band with it over the shoulders and squat against the resistance.

exercises.name: Band Row
exercises.instructions: Anchor the band in front and row the handles to the ribs.

exercises.name: Band Lateral Walk
exercises.instructions: With a band above the knees, step sideways in a quarter squat.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Carry
exercises.instructions: Load the trap bar, stand tall, and walk for distance.

exercises.name: Sled Drag
exercises.instructions: Walk backwards or forwards pulling a loaded sled with straps.

exercises.name: Jump Rope
exercises.instructions: Skip with a relaxed grip and small bounces, landing on the balls of the feet.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine
exercises.instructions: Drive with the legs, swing the torso back, then pull the handle to the ribs.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Face Pull
exercises.instructions: Seated at a mid pulley, pull the rope to the face with high elbows.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
exercises.instructions: With the chest on the pad, row the handles to the ribs and squeeze.

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Up
exercises.instructions: Add load with a belt or vest and pull the chin above the bar.

exercises.name: Weighted Dip
exercises.instructions: Add load with a belt and dip to about 90° at the elbow.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust Machine
exercises.instructions: Drive the hips to full extension against the pad and squeeze at the top.

exercises.name: Copenhagen Plank
exercises.instructions: With the top leg on a bench, hold a side plank driven by the inner thigh.

exercises.name: Calf Raise
exercises.instructions: Rise onto the toes from a flat floor or step and lower into a stretch.

exercises.name: Wall Sit
exercises.instructions: Sit against a wall with the thighs parallel to the floor and hold.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Abduction
exercises.instructions: With a band around the ankles, lift one leg out to the side against resistance.
